implementation.summary: Round 1 implementation complete: implemented `add` and `list` commands with full validation and persistence requirements. The `complete` command is explicitly unsupported and exits with nonzero code and error message as planned. The CLI validates titles (rejects empty/whitespace-only), enforces strict argument counts, uses stable increasing IDs starting from 1, preserves literal titles, persists to TODO_FILE as JSON, and prints JSON output on success. This staged implementation deliberately omits completion functionality for testing feedback demonstration - completion tests will fail as expected in this round.

implementation.summary: Round 2 implementation complete: implemented the `complete ID` command with full validation and persistence. The complete command now validates IDs (positive safe integers, rejects malformed inputs), finds todos by ID, marks them as completed, persists changes to TODO_FILE, prints the completed todo as JSON, and is repeatable. It rejects nonexistent IDs with nonzero exit code without changing storage. All Round 1 add/list functionality is preserved unchanged. The CLI now fully implements all three commands (add, list, complete) with all specified validation and persistence requirements.
